title: memory-lens: the few memories that matter, on every prompt
description: A new mod indexes the project's Claude Code memory files at session start and, on each prompt, sends the top 3 matches above a score floor to the model as one context entry and draws one line for the human. Measured on Claude Code 2.1.283: the context reaches the model, the line draws in the terminal, query p95 3.4 ms. Try it on a made-up corpus.
